description: This file is a shell library for common merge tool functions used in a git environment, providing functions for managing merge tools, diff tools, their configurations, and execution within a git workflow.

methods.name: mode_ok
methods.description: Checks if the current mode is either diff or merge.

methods.name: is_available
methods.description: Checks if a specified merge tool is available in the environment.

methods.name: list_config_tools
methods.description: Lists configured tools under a specific git config section.

methods.name: show_tool_names
methods.description: Displays available tool names based on conditions and configurations.

methods.name: diff_mode
methods.description: Returns true if in diff mode.

methods.name: merge_mode
methods.description: Returns true if in merge mode.

methods.name: get_gui_default
methods.description: Determines if GUI mode is default based on the configuration and environment.

methods.name: gui_mode
methods.description: Returns true if GUI mode is enabled.

methods.name: translate_merge_tool_path
methods.description: Returns the path to the merge tool, translating if necessary.

methods.name: check_unchanged
methods.description: Checks if the merged file is unchanged after a merge attempt.

methods.name: valid_tool
methods.description: Validates the existence and correctness of a specified merge tool.

methods.name: setup_user_tool
methods.description: Sets up a user-specified merge tool with default behavior.

methods.name: setup_tool
methods.description: Initializes a specific merge or diff tool, overriding defaults.

methods.name: get_merge_tool_cmd
methods.description: Retrieves the command for the specified merge tool.

methods.name: trust_exit_code
methods.description: Checks if the merge tool's exit code can be trusted.

methods.name: initialize_merge_tool
methods.description: Brings tool-specific functions into scope.

methods.name: run_merge_tool
methods.description: Entry point for executing the merge or diff tool.

methods.name: run_diff_cmd
methods.description: Runs a configured diff command.

methods.name: run_merge_cmd
methods.description: Runs a configured merge command, handling exit code trust.

methods.name: list_merge_tool_candidates
methods.description: Generates a list of candidate merge tools based on environment.

methods.name: show_tool_help
methods.description: Displays help information for available tools.

methods.name: guess_merge_tool
methods.description: Attempts to automatically determine an appropriate merge tool.

methods.name: get_configured_merge_tool
methods.description: Retrieves the currently configured merge tool, or attempts to determine one.

methods.name: get_merge_tool_path
methods.description: Gets the path to the merge tool executable.

methods.name: get_merge_tool
methods.description: Gets the merge tool, either configured or guessed.

methods.name: mergetool_find_win32_cmd
methods.description: Locates the Windows executable for a tool, looking in PATH or standard directories.
